title: Group Room Blocks Free-Reduction Allowance
content:
A signed reduction addendum on a Group Room Blocks contract is implemented for the room nights it requests, up to the free-reduction allowance still open on the block.

### Quantities

1. **Room nights requested** — the requested room nights written on the most recently issued reduction addendum whose status is signed.
2. **Free-reduction allowance** — the reduction percentage of the room nights the allowance is measured on, rounded down to a whole room night, plus the courtesy room nights. The reduction percentage is the block type's free-reduction percentage; the room nights the allowance is measured on are the room nights of the block's allocation entry, which are the room nights contracted at signing; and the courtesy room nights are none.
3. **Allowance still open** — the free-reduction allowance less the earlier reductions counted against it, rounded down to a whole room night and never below zero. The earlier reductions counted against it are the room nights of the reduction entries already on the block ledger, counted in full.
4. **Room nights removed** — the lesser of the room nights requested and the allowance still open.

Room nights an addendum requests beyond the allowance still open are not removed: they stay in the contracted room nights and any shortfall on them is settled under the attrition clause after the event.

The days before arrival of a reduction are counted as whole calendar days to the block's arrival date from the date the addendum is implemented.

### Worksheet (hypothetical block; the free-reduction percentage is assumed at 10 percent for the illustration)

| Line | Figure |
|---|---|
| Allocation entry (room nights contracted at signing) | 200 |
| 10 percent of 200, rounded down | 20 |
| Courtesy room nights | none |
| Free-reduction allowance | 20 |
| Reduction entries already on the ledger | 8 |
| Allowance still open: 20 less 8 | 12 |
| Room nights requested on the signed addendum | 15 |
| Room nights removed: the lesser of 15 and 12 | 12 |
| Requested room nights that stay in the contract | 3 |

### Further cases on the same assumptions

| Allocation entry | Earlier reduction entries | Requested | Allowance | Still open | Removed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 200 | 0 | 5 | 20 | 20 | 5 |
| 185 | 0 | 30 | 18 (18.5 rounded down) | 18 | 18 |
| 200 | 25 | 10 | 20 | 0 (never below zero) | 0 |
